svg.title: N-gram sliding window
svg.desc: A window slides across "Thou shalt not make a machine in the likeness of a human mind"; each position gives an (input 1, input 2, output) training example.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: A sliding window turns running text into n-gram training data
